observations.posthog_connection: Retrieves the request ID from the current HTTP request context to use as a join key for PostHog events.
Generates a unique, per-event span ID to distinguish multiple PostHog events emitted within a single LLM request, while the shared request_id is used to join them to the access log.
Removes the per-event UUID generation, relying instead on the shared request_id and the new unique span_id implementation.
